text: The LightGBM model from Lesson 12 scored an offline AUC of about 0.98. Before anyone celebrates further, Felix's team needs to know which features actually drive that number.
SHAP's TreeExplainer breaks every prediction into per-feature contributions, and a summary plot ranks which features matter most across the entire validation set.
Two features dominate everything else by a wide margin: logins_last_30d and days_since_last_login, far ahead of SeatCount, MonthlyRevenue, or any other signal in the model.
A force plot on one flagged account shows almost the whole prediction coming from those same two features. It reads as usage drop-off predicting churn -- intuitive, so nobody digs further yet.
The model is explained and trusted. Next: putting it to work in production, for real.
